learning_outcomes.text: To enable students to understand the basic principles of plastic forming and machining processes.
To provide the fundamentals of calculating forming and cutting forces and power requirements.
To explain the importance of economic and productive manufacturing.

syllabus_topics: Manufacturing Quality, Machine Tools and Classification of Machining
Fundamentals of Machining, Chip Formation, Chip Types, Orthogonal and Oblique Cutting
Tool Geometry, Cutting Forces, Cutting Power, Heat Generation
Cutting Fluids and Surface Roughness, Machinability
Unconventional Machining Methods, Dimensional Measurement and Statistical Quality Control, Manufacturing Systems and Automation, Fundamentals of Tool and Die Design
Deformation Processes, Deformation Forces and Energy Requirement, Forging, Extrusion, Drawing, Rolling, Sheet Metal Forming Processes, Punching, Cutting, Bending, Deep Drawing
bibliography: Fundamentals of Modern Manufacturing: Materials, Processes and Systems by M.P. GROOVER, John Wiley & Sons, 2010
